preamble: Direct vocalization of syllable-final [l] to the mid back vowel [o] is the hallmark of Štokavian Serbo-Croatian: Proto-Slavic coda *l became o, creating a new syllable (pepeo 'ash', posao 'work', past participles in -ao/-io). The lateral reappears wherever a vowel follows (genitive pepela, posla). Other languages usually vocalize dark l to [u] or [w], which may later merge into [o] only through further changes (e.g. French au > o).

examples.note: Genitive pepela keeps the lateral before a vowel.
Coda /l/ fully vocalized to /o/; Kajkavian and Torlakian dialects did not undergo the change.
